Man may practise thousands of self-mortifications and clevernesses, O dear, but not even one avails him.

They, who are the disbelievers in the World-Lord, their family is branded with stigma.

ਸਮਾਲਹਿ, ਸੰਭਾਲਦੇ ਹਨ, ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਵਸਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ।

He crosses the sea of grief and swims across the dreadful world ocean.

He, whom You likest, O Beloved, him, You unitest with You and he alone is ever true.

The Bright Lord is Omnipotent and compassionate and His devotees have His support alone.

I have surrendered to the refuge of Him, O dear, who is wise and the knower of hearts.

her teeth are without filth and her mind is split not and on her tongue is His True Name.

Servant Nanak is the servant of God and the slave is the servant of God and the slave of the slaves of the Great True Guru.

Nanak, they are not said to have died, who are absorbed in the Guru's hymns.

I am a slave and servant of Yours. Command me, as it pleases You.

By Guru's grace, I shall serve You, as the Guru instructs me.

According to the past writ, which the Creator Himself wrote, must man act.
N1NY: Emotional attachment has drugged him, and he has forgotten the Lord, the treasure of virtue.
The worldly love has thrown its net of deception over him and he has forgotten the Treasure of virtue.

Deem him not alive in this world, He is dead through love of duality.

Their face is blackened among men and they heave in heavy breath.

In the egocentrics, no one places reliance. Trust in them is lost.

Nanak, the Guru-wards, within whose mind abides the Name, enjoy great peace.

They are the relatives and they, the friends, who are resigned to Guru's will and meet me with love.

Night and day, they act according to True Guru's will and they remain absorbed in the True Name.

They, who practise ego and evil and are attached to another in love, and not called friends.
5N3Y: The self-willed manmukhs are selfish; they cannot resolve anyone's affairs.
The way-wards are selfish, they cannot adjust other's affairs.

Nanak, they act in accordance with what is pre-destined for them; none can erase it.

Having created the world Yourself, You Yourself has arranged the play.

They, whom God Himself blesses with His grace, them, the Guru instructs.

Nanak, they alone obtain the Name in whose destiny it is so writ by the Lord, from the beginning.

Just as the deer knows not its own musk and wanders about guided by doubt.

The Perfect Guru has shown the Lord to me and, through Guru's service, is He obtained.

As if my body has been crushed in an oil-press without yielding even a drop of blood.

as by applying a base, the clothes are dyed with madder.

The Name in this world in difficult to obtain but through the Guru, it comes to abide in man's mind.

Nanak, he who serves his Guru, to him, I am a sacrifice.
CWLR: The mind of the self-willed manmukh is so very stubborn; it is stuck in the love of duality.
The mind of an apostate is adamant and is attached to another.
BMZ5: He does not find peace, even in dreams; he passes his life in misery and suffering.
He obtains not peace even in dream and passes his life in extreme misery.
T5V1: The Pandits have grown weary of going door to door, reading and reciting their scriptures; the Siddhas have gone into their trances of Samaadhi.
The Pandits grow weary of reading and reciting from door to door and the adepts of going into trance.
R987: This mind cannot be controlled; they are tired of performing religious rituals.
The mortals are tired of performing religious rites, but their mind comes not under control.
PZN5: The impersonators have grown weary of wearing false costumes, and bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines.
The pseudo-saints grow weary of wearing false dresses and bathing at sixty-eight shrines.

DS9F: They do not know the state of their own minds; they are deluded by doubt and egotism.
They know not the state of their mind and are misled by pride and doubt.
F1SX: By Guru's Grace, the Fear of God is obtained; by great good fortune, the Lord comes to abide in the mind.
By Guru's grace God's fear is obtained and by great good fortune God comes and abides in the mind.

When the Lord's fear is obtained, the mind is restrained and, through the Name, ego is burnt down.

Pure are they, who are imbued with the True Name and their light merges in the supreme light.
A717: Meeting the True Guru, one obtains the Name; O Nanak, he is absorbed in peace. ||2||
Meeting the True Guru, the mortal obtains the Name and is absorbed in bliss.
PFLT: The pleasures of kings and emperors are pleasing, but they last for only a few days.
These revelments of the monarchs and Kings look pleasing for four days.
7WNG: These pleasures of Maya are like the color of the safflower, which wears off in a moment.
These enjoyment of wealth are like the colour of safflower, which wears off in a moment.
MAU0: They do not go with him when he departs; instead, he carries the load of sins upon his head.
The wealth goes not with the man, when he departs. He carries the load of sins on his head.
F7VY: When death seizes him, and marches him away, then he looks absolutely hideous.
When death seizes and drives him, on, then extremely dreadful he looks.
JRPM: That lost opportunity will not come into his hands again, and in the end, he regrets and repents. ||6||
That time, when he could meditate on God, returns not to man's hand again and he ultimately regrets.
56UR: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru, suffer in sorrow and bondage.
They, who turn their face away from the True Guru, suffer sorrow tied down.
ZDM0: Again and again, they are born only to die; they cannot meet their Lord.
Over and over they come and go and cannot meet with their Lord.
3BKD: The disease of doubt does not depart, and they find only pain and more pain.
Their disease of doubt departs not and, in pain, they obtain more pain.
N6TY: O Nanak, if the Gracious Lord forgives, then one is united in Union with the Word of the Shabad. ||1||
Nanak, If the Merciful Master forgives the man, then He unites him in the Name's union.
QRMM: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru, shall find no place of rest or shelter.
They, who turn their back upon the True Guru, find no place or room of refuge.
7K0J: They wander around from door to door, like a woman forsaken, with a bad character and a bad reputation.
They wander from door to door like a divorced woman of bad character and evil repute.
88M8: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are forgiven, and united in Union with the True Guru. ||2||
Nanak, the pious persons, who are granted pardon, they associate with the True Guru's society.
LGK2: Those who serve the True Lord, the Destroyer of ego, cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
They, who server the True Lord, the slayer of Mur demon, swim, across the terrible ocean.
WW20: Those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are passed over by the Messenger of Death.
They, who repeat the Lord God's Name, them, the death's courier passes by.
CT83: Those who meditate on the Lord, go to His Court in robes of honor.
They, who meditate one God, go to His Court wearing the robe of honour.
YZQS: They alone serve You, O Lord, whom You bless with Grace.
Those persons alone serve You, O God, on whom is Yours grace.
2ZX5: I sing continually Your Glorious Praises, O Beloved; as Gurmukh, my doubts and fears have been dispelled. ||7||
My Beloved, I ever sing, Your praise. Through the Guru, my doubt and dread are dispelled.

This fare is rarely obtained, O saints; it is obtained by reflecting over Guru's hymns.

The Satguru has set this problem Its solution the Sikhs of the Guru have found after a search.
9T6L: O Nanak, he alone understands this, whom the Lord inspires to understand. The Gurmukhs work hard, and find the Lord. ||1||
Nanak, he whom Guru instruction. understands this riddle. Through arduous service the holy obtain God.
2CWH: Those whom the Primal Lord unites, remain in Union with Him; they focus their consciousness on the True Guru.
They whom the Primal Lord unites, remain united with Him. They fix their mind on the True Guru.
QS76: Those whom the Lord Himself separates, remain separated; in the love of duality, they are ruined.
They, whom the Lord Himself separates remain separated from Him, and they are ruined through another's love.
Z67G: O Nanak, without good karma, what can anyone obtain? He earns what he is pre-destined to receive. ||2||
Nanak, what can be obtained without God's grace? The mortal earns, what is pre-destined for him.
U2B9: Sitting together, the companions sing the Songs of the Lord's Praises.
Sitting together, the singing mates chant the Lord's praise.
CFHH: They praise the Lord's Name continually; they are a sacrifice to the Lord.
They ever praise the God's Name and are a sacrifice to God.
V0T6: Those who hear, and believe in the Lord's Name, to them I am a sacrifice.
They, who hear and believe in the Lord's Name, to them, I am a sacrifice.
LD71: O Lord, let me unite with the Gurmukhs, who are united with You.
O God, make me meet with the pious mates, who are competent to unite me with You.
Q9JL: I am a sacrifice to those who, day and night, behold their Guru. ||8||
Day and night I am dedicated to those, who behold their Guru.

CYLM: Without the Name of the Lord, everyone wanders around the world, losing.
Without the Name, all, ever wander about in the universe and they suffer loss in the world.
1WB8: The self-willed manmukhs do their deeds in the pitch black darkness of egotism.
The way-ward person do the deeds in the pitch darkness of egotism.

The Guru-wards drink Nectar, by reflecting over the Name O Nanak.
KRLF: He wakes in peace, and he sleeps in peace.
The Pious person wakes in peace and in peace he sleep.
F41U: The Gurmukh praises the Lord night and day.
Night and day he praises his Lord.
CDXJ: The self-willed manmukh remains deluded by his doubts.
Engrossed in doubt, the self willed wanders about.
963T: He is filled with anxiety, and he cannot even sleep.
Within him is anxiety and he sleeps not a peaceful sleep.
VG9Y: The spiritually wise wake and sleep in peace.
The theologians wake and sleep in peace.
7SYN: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who are imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
Nanak is a sacrifice to those, who are imbued with God.
F4J5: They alone meditate on the Lord's Name, who are imbued with the Lord.
They alone remember the God's Name, who are imbued with God.
H5Q0: They meditate on the One Lord; the One and Only Lord is True.
They meditate on One God. The One Lord alone is true.
UB4S: The One Lord is pervading everywhere; the One Lord created the Universe.
God alone is pervading all. From the One Lord alone is all the creation.
3C4U: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name, cast out their fears.
They, who ponder over the Lord's Name, cast away fear altogether.
5ER2: The Lord Himself blesses them with Guru's Instruction; the Gurmukh meditates on the Lord. ||9||
The Lord Himself blesses man with the Guru's instruction and, through the Guru, meditates he, on the Lord.
H1ZY: Spiritual wisdom, which would bring understanding, does not enter into his mind.
Divine knowledge, from which substantial understanding is obtained, enters not man's mind.
A5FD: Without seeing, how can he praise the Lord? The blind act in blindness.

Nanak, when the mortal realises the Lord, the Name comes to abide in his mind.
9Z5B: There is One Bani; there is One Guru; there is one Shabad to contemplate.
There is but one Divine sermon, uttered by the only Guru; there is One Name to reflect upon.
6WKK: True is the merchandise, and true is the shop; the warehouses are overflowing with jewels.
True is the merchandise, true the shop and true the garners filled with jewels.
CB2H: By Guru's Grace, they are obtained, if the Great Giver gives them.
If the Beneficent Lord bestows, then alone are they obtained by the Guru's grace.
PFHX: Dealing in this true merchandise, one earns the profit of the incomparable Naam.
Dealing in this true merchandise, the man ever earns the profit of the unique Name.
DUZ3: In the midst of poison, the Ambrosial Nectar is revealed; by His Mercy, one drinks it in.
In this very world of poison, the Name-Nectar becomes manifest and by the Lord's grace alone is it quaffed.
7DB9: O Nanak, praise the True Lord; blessed is the Creator, the Embellisher. ||2||
Nanak, praise you the True Lord, Blessed is, He, the Embellisher of the mortals.

They, within whom is pervading falsehood, love not the truth.
NMV0: If someone speaks the Truth, falsehood is burnt away.
If some one tells the truth, the false one is burnt.
GG64: The false are satisfied by falsehood, like the crows who eat manure.
As the crow eats up ordure, so is the false one satiated with falsehood.
A5H1: When the Lord grants His Grace, then one meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
He, to whom the Lord become merciful, meditates on the Name.

Through the Guru, remember you the Lord's Name, and you shall be rid of falsehood and sin.

Prostrate yourself before the True Guru. He, the Omniscient Satguru knows everything.
0SJ2: Burn away your hopes and desires, and live like a guest in this world.
Burn you yours hopes and desires and remain as a guest in this world.
UNX3: If you walk in harmony with the True Guru's Will, then you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.
Even now, if you walkest according to the True Guru's will, then, shall you obtain honour in the Lord's court.
AWEU: O Nanak, those who do not contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord - cursed are their clothes, and cursed is their food. ||1||
Nanak, they, who contemplate not on the Name, accursed is their dress and accursed their food.

Nanak, the Guru-wards utter the Lord's praise and in the Lord's praise they remain absorbed.
RFQT: The Lord has adorned the coat of the body; He has embroidered it with devotional worship.
God has adorned the body jacket. Embroidering it with the Lord's meditation, wear it I.
4RKP: The Lord has woven His silk into it, in so many ways and fashions.
The silk of the Lord's Name is set thereon in plenty, in multiple manners and in various ways.
PXF3: How rare is that man of understanding, who understands, and deliberates within.
Rare is the man of understanding who understands this mystery by deeply deliberating in his mind.
RFA7: He alone understands these deliberations, whom the Lord Himself inspires to understand.
He alone understands this deliberation whom the Lord Himself causes to understand.
W8JH: Poor servant Nanak speaks: the Gurmukhs know the Lord, the Lord is True. ||11||
Says poor slave Nanak, the Guru-wards deem God to be the ever True Lord.

0C9D: Great men speak the teachings by relating them to individual situations, but the whole world shares in them.
Great men utter instruction apropos some spiritual motive, but the whole world becomes a partner therein.
UHY3: One who becomes Gurmukh knows the Fear of God, and realizes his own self.
He, who turns Guru-ward imbibes Lord's fear and recognises his ownself.
2JTJ: If, by Guru's Grace, one remains dead while yet alive, the mind becomes content in itself.
If by Guru's grace, man remains dead in life, then his mind becomes content from the mind itself.

Nanak, how can they, who have no faith in their mind, expound divine knowledge?
X208: Those who do not focus their consciousness on the Lord, as Gurmukh, suffer pain and grief in the end.
They, who fix not their mind on God, through the Guru, are overtaken by grief in the end.
9X0K: They are blind, inwardly and outwardly, and they do not understand anything.
From within and without, they are blind and attain not any understanding.
FVKV: O Pandit, O religious scholar, the whole world is fed for the sake of those who are attuned to the Lord's Name.
O Pandit, the whole world is fed for the sake of those, who are imbued with the God's Name.
JHLL: Those who praise the Word of the Guru's Shabad, remain blended with the Lord.
They, who praise the Lord, by Guru's instruction, remain blended with the Lord.
1MFY: O Pandit, O religious scholar, no one is satisfied, and no one finds true wealth through the love of duality.
O Pandit, through duality, satisfaction is not possible, nor is the Lord's wealth obtained.
LBLS: They have grown weary of reading scriptures, but still, they do not find contentment, and they pass their lives burning, night and day.
Through grown weary of reading, men obtain not contentment and pass their life burning night and day.
N1A6: Their cries and complaints never end, and doubt does not depart from within them.
Their cries and complaints end not, nor departs the doubt from within them.

Nanak, without the name, they arise and depart with blackened face.

The friend, who shows me the God's path, to him I am a sacrifice.

With him, I shall share his virtues and contemplate over the Lord's Name.

QKNF: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has imparted this understanding to me. ||12||
I am devoted to the True Guru, who has infused understanding within me.

Even though you readest the Vedas for four ages, you shall not be freed of the filth, O Pandit.

The three modes are the roots of worldly attachments. In ego, the mortal forgets the Name.

The Pandits are deluded, being attached to another and they deal in worldly goods.

5ZRF: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.
By serving the True Guru and remembering the True Name, I have obtained peace.
QAEK: Hunger and thirst have departed from within me; I am in love with the True Name.
By enshrining affection for the True Name, desires and cravings have departed from within me.
17XU: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam, who keep the Lord clasped tightly to their hearts, are automatically satisfied. ||1||
Nanak, they who are imbued with the name and who keep the Lord clasped to their heart are automatically satiated.
K2JS: The self-willed manmukh does not serve the Lord's Name, and so he suffers in horrible pain.
The way-ward person serves not God's Name, so immense anguish overtakes him.
2Z34: He is filled with the darkness of ignorance, and he does not understand anything.
Within him is the darkness of spiritual ignorance and he acquires not understanding.
VYSG: Because of his stubborn mind, he does not plant the seeds of intuitive peace; what will he eat in the world hereafter, to satisfy his hunger?
Through his mind's obstinacy he sows not the seed of the Lord's Name, When hungry, what shall he eat hereafter.
QR02: He has forgotten the treasure of the Naam; he is caught in the love of duality.
He has forgotten the name treasures, being attached with another.
FHNV: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are honored with glory, when the Lord Himself unites them in His Union. ||2||
Nanak, the Guru-wards obtain honour, when the Lord Himself unites them in His union.
TFDX: The tongue which sings the Lord's Praises, is so very beautiful.
Very beauteous is the tongue which sings the Lord God's praise.
104P: One who speaks the Lord's Name, with mind, body and mouth, is pleasing to the Lord.
The woman, who with her mind, body and mouth utters God's Name, she is pleasing to the Lord.
1SQ5: That Gurmukh tastes the the sublime taste of the Lord, and is satisfied.
She, who, by Guru's grace, tastes Lord's relish, is satiated.
2UDN: She sings continually the Glorious Praises of her Beloved; singing His Glorious Praises, she is uplifted.
Reforming herself, she chants the virtues of the virtuous Lord and ever sings the praise of her Beloved.
T0EU: She is blessed with the Lord's Mercy, and she chants the Words of the Guru, the True Guru. ||13||
She, to whom the Lord Himself becomes merciful, utters the hymns of the great True Guru.

As the elephant offers his head to the goad and as the anvil offers itself to the hammer.
A3NN: just so, we offer our minds and bodies to our Guru; we stand before Him, and serve Him.
So place, you, your soul and body, before the Guru and ever stand and serve him.

In this way, having effaced his ego, the Guru-ward assumes the sovereignty of the whole world.
E8G9: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||
Nanak, when the Lord casts His gracious glance, then alone, man understands this, through the Guru.
9MUB: Blessed and approved is the coming into the world, of those Gurmukhs who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
They, who, through the Guru, meditate on the Name, their advent into the world becomes acceptable.
Q0T6: O Nanak, they save their families, and they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||
Nanak, they save their progeny and obtain honour in the Lord's court.
CGRR: The Guru unites His Sikhs, the Gurmukhs, with the Lord.
The pious Sikh mates, the Guru unites with the Lord.
S0EX: The Guru keeps some of them with Himself, and engages others in His Service.
Some servants the Guru keeps in his presence and some others the Guru engages in his service.
C0AW: Those who cherish their Beloved in their conscious minds, the Guru blesses them with His Love.
They, who cherish the beloved Guru in their mind and heart, then, the Guru blesses with the Lord's love.
9X5L: The Guru loves all of His Gursikhs equally well, like friends, children and siblings.
The Guru equally loves all the Gur-sikhs, like his friends, sons and brothers.
Y263: So chant the Name of the Guru, the True Guru, everyone! Chanting the Name of the Guru, Guru, you shall be rejuvenated. ||14||
Utter you all, the great True Guru's Name. By uttering the great Guru's Name, the man is reanimated.
Z4G6: O Nanak, the blind, ignorant fools do not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they involve themselves in other activities.
Nanak, the unwise, blind ones, contemplate not on the Name, and engage themselves in other deeds.
T5AL: They are bound and gagged at the door of the Messenger of Death; they are punished, and in the end, they rot away in manure. ||1||
Bound at the death's courier's door they are punished and ultimately they rot in ordure.
872P: O Nanak, those humble beings are true and approved, who serve their True Guru.
Nanak, true and approved are the persons, who serve their True Guru.
W8FS: They remain absorbed in the Name of the Lord, and their comings and goings cease. ||2||
In the God's Name, they remain absorbed and their comings and goings cease.
ZH30: Gathering the wealth and property of Maya, brings only pain in the end.
The amassing of wealth, property and riches becomes distressful in the end.
KW1E: Homes, mansions and adorned palaces will not go with anyone.
The bedecked home, mansions and palaces, none of them goes with the man.
NC4N: He may breed horses of various colors, but these will not be of any use to him.
The mortal ever nurses steeds of various colours, but they are of no avail whatsoever.
50VB: O human, link your consciousness to the Lord's Name, and in the end, it shall be your companion and helper.
O man, attach you your mind with God's Name and in the end it shall be your succour.
JJC8: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukh is blessed with peace. ||15||
By Guru's grace, slave Nanak has remembered the Name and he is blessed with peace.
2B61: Without the karma of good actions, the Name is not obtained; it can be obtained only by perfect good karma.
Without God's grace, the name is not obtained, it can be obtained only through perfect destiny.
ADYQ: O Nanak, if the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, then under Guru's Instruction, one is united in His Union. ||1||
Nanak, if the Lord casts His gracious glance then, by Guru's instruction, the mortal unites in His union.
P9LX: Some are cremated, and some are buried; some are eaten by dogs.
Some are cremated some buried and some the dogs eat.
N90N: Some are thrown into water, while others are thrown into wells.
Some are thrown into water and some, again, are cast into tower of silence.
Y8EY: O Nanak, it is not known, where they go and into what they merge. ||2||
Nanak, this much is not known as to where do they go and disappear?

YS7N: The food and clothes, and all the worldly possessions of those who are attuned to the Lord's Name are sacred.

F08J: All the rituals and Dharmic practices and deeds are sacred, for those who utter the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the True Name of the Lord.
Pure are all the rites, faiths and deeds of those, who utter Lord God, and the Name of the True Lord God.
QF74: Those Gurmukhs, those Sikhs, who have purity as their treasure, go to their Guru. ||16||
The pious Gur-sikhs who have piety in their treasure, they alone repair to the Guru.
ZDEV: O Nanak, forsaking the Name, he loses everything, in this world and the next.
Nanak, forsaking the Name, man loses all, this world and the world beyond.
WYVT: Chanting, deep meditation and austere self-disciplined practices are all wasted; he is deceived by the love of duality.
His worship, penance and self discipline are all wasted and he is beguiled by another's love.
UERB: He is bound and gagged at the door of the Messenger of Death. He is beaten, and receives terrible punishment. ||1||
Bound at the death-courier's door he is beaten and is awarded great punishment.

K8A0: They inflict their hatred upon the Saints, and they love the wicked sinners.
The slanderers bear enmity to the saints and cultivate love and affection with the sinners.
MPTM: They find no peace in either this world or the next; they are born only to die, again and again.
Here and hereafter, they attain not peace and come and go again and again.
56BE: Their hunger is never satisfied, and they are ruined by duality.
Their desire is never stilled and they are ruined by duality.
33WK: The faces of these slanderers are blackened in the Court of the True Lord.
The faces of those slanderers are blackened in that true court of the Lord.
HW0G: O Nanak, without the Naam, they find no shelter on either this shore, or the one beyond. ||2||
Nanak, without the Name, the mortals finds refuge neither at this shore nor at the yonder one.
SCYK: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name, are imbued with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in their minds.
They, who meditate on the Lord's name, in their mind, they are imbued with the Lord's God's Name.
AL7B: For those who worship the One Lord in their conscious minds, there is no other than the One Lord.
Whosoever in their heart and mind, dwell on the One Lord, without the One Lord, they recognise not another.

0G1D: They alone serve the Lord, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is written.
Those persons alone serve the Lord, on whose forehead such a writ is written by the Lord.
B9R8: They continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and singing the Glories of the Glorious Lord, they are uplifted.
They chant ever the God's glories, and, singing the praise of the meritorious Lord, instruct their mind.
ZKL8: Great is the greatness of the Gurmukhs, who, through the Perfect Guru, remain absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||17||
Great is the greatness of the pious persons who, through the Perfect Guru, remain absorbed in the Lord's Name.
EW3T: It is very difficult to serve the True Guru; offer your head, and eradicate self-conceit.
Hard is the service of the True Guru, as the devotee has to surrender his head and efface his ownself.
3D43: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad shall never have to die again; his service is totally approved.
If he dies by Guru's instruction, he dies not again and then his entire service becomes acceptable.
7Z0Z: Touching the philosopher's stone, one becomes the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold; remain lovingly attached to the True Lord.
Touching the philosopher's stone, he is transformed into philosopher's stone and remains attached in love with the True Lord.
J1BC: One who has such pre-ordained destiny, comes to meet the True Guru and God.
He, who is so pre-destined, him, the Lord-incarnate, True Guru, comes to meet.
MVWY: O Nanak, the Lord's servant does not meet Him because of his own account; he alone is acceptable, whom the Lord forgives. ||1||
Nanak, by reckoning the slave meets not with his Lord. He, whom the Lord forgives, becomes acceptable.

9YXA: The fools do not know the difference between good and bad; they are deceived by their self-interests.
Strayed by their self-interest, the fools distinguish not good from bad.
FB5G: But if they contemplate the Word of the Shabad, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and their light merges in the Light.
If they contemplate on the Name, then obtain they, the Lord's presence and their light merges into the Supreme light.
506W: The Fear of God is always on their minds, and so they come to understand everything.
When the True Lord's fear is ever enshrined in their mind, it is then that they attain all the understanding.
1UWN: The True Guru is pervading the homes within; He Himself blends them with the Lord.
The True Guru abides in their very home, and he himself blends them with their Lord.
DTR5: O Nanak, they meet the True Guru, and all their desires are fulfilled, if the Lord grants His Grace and so wills. ||2||
Nanak, he, to whom the Lord shows His mercy and benevolence, meets with the True Guru and all, his desires are fulfilled.
G45N: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those devotees, who, with their mouths, utter the Name of the Lord.
Blest! blest is the destiny of those saintly persons, who, with their mouth, utter God. and the God's Name.
31EJ: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those Saints, who, with their ears, listen to the Lord's Praises.
Blessed! blessed is the destiny of the holy men, who, with their ears, hear God's praise.
C8WD: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those holy people, who sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and so become virtuous.
Blessed! blessed! is the destiny of the good people, who, by singing God's praise, become virtuous persons.
4V7E: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those Gurmukhs, who live as Gursikhs, and conquer their minds.
Auspicious! auspicious is the fortune of the pious persons, who, acting on Guru's instruction, conquer their mind.
50D9: But the greatest good fortune of all, is that of the Guru's Sikhs, who fall at the Guru's feet. ||18||
The highest of all is the fortune of the Sikhs of the Guru. True Guru sikh fall at the Guru's feet.
QTYX: One who knows God, and who lovingly focuses his attention on the One Word of the Shabad, keeps his spirituality intact.
He, who knows the Lord and fixes his attention on the one Name, keeps intact his Brahman-hood.
5MNA: The nine treasures and the eighteen spiritual powers of the Siddhas follow him, who keeps the Lord enshrined in his heart.
The nine treasures and eighteen miraculous powers go after him, who ever keeps enshrined the Lord within his mind.
B7YE: Without the True Guru, the Name is not found; understand this, and reflect upon it.
Without the True Guru, the Name is obtained not; understand and reflect you over it.
Y3C1: O Nanak, through perfect good destiny, one meets the True Guru, and finds peace, throughout the four ages. ||1||
Nanak, through perfect destiny, man meets the True Guru and gathers peace, the four ages through.
CRGX: Whether he is young or old, the self-willed manmukh cannot escape hunger and thirst.
Whether young or whether old, the thirst and hunger of the way-ward person depart not.
9L6K: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the Word of the Shabad; they are at peace, having lost their self-conceit.
The Guru-wards are imbued with the name and are pacified, losing their self-conceit.

M7N4: They are satisfied and satiated within; they never feel hungry again.
Their mind is sated and satiated and they feel not hungry again.

A72M: O Nanak, whatever the Gurmukhs do is acceptable; they remain lovingly absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
Nanak, whatever the Guru-wards, who remain absorbed in the Name's love, do, that, becomes acceptable.
EQAC: I am a sacrifice to those Sikhs who are Gurmukhs.
I am a sacrifice to those, who are the God-conscious sikhs of the Guru.
FNG8: I behold the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of those who meditate on the Lord's Name.
I see the sight of those, who meditate on the Lord's Name.
J0TV: Listening to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, I contemplate His virtues; I write His Praises on the fabric of my mind.
Hearing Lord's praise, I utter His virtues and inscribe God's glory in my mind.
NA6M: I praise the Lord's Name with love, and eradicate all my sins.
I praise the Lord's Name with love and up-root all my sins.
WW3K: Blessed, blessed and beauteous is that body and place, where my Guru places His feet. ||19||
Blest, blest and beauteous is the body and place, whereon my Guru plant his foot.
LXKZ: Without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained, and peace does not come to abide in the mind.
Without the Guru, gnosis is not obtained, nor peace comes and abides in the mind.
0M9K: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the self-willed manmukhs depart, after having wasted their lives. ||1||
Nanak, without the Name, the self-willed shall depart after wasting their life.
6BSC: All the Siddhas, spiritual masters and seekers search for the Name; they have grown weary of concentrating and focusing their attention.
All the adepts and strivers seek to attain the name and grow weary of fixing their attention.
5UZS: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Name; the Gurmukhs unite in Union with the Lord.
Without the True Guru, none attains the Name it is only through the Guru, that the Name is received.
U5VX: Without the Name, all food and clothes are worthless; cursed is such spirituality, and cursed are such miraculous powers.
Without the Name in vain are all the robes and dishes and accursed is the saintliness and accursed the supernatural-power.
MQDA: That alone is spirituality, and that alone is miraculous power, which the Carefree Lord spontaneously bestows.
That alone is the saintliness and that the occult-power, which the carefree Lord gives as His gift.
QS2K: O Nanak, the Lord's Name abides in the mind of the Gurmukh; this is spirituality, and this is miraculous power. ||2||
Nanak, through the Guru, the Lord's Name abides in the mind. This alone is the miraculous might and this the extra psychic power.

9CDL: I am a minstrel of God, my Lord and Master; every day, I sing the songs of the Lord's Glorious Praises.
I am a minstrel of God, my Lord Master, and I daily sing the songs of God's praise.
U596: I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and I listen to the Praises of the Lord, the Master of wealth and Maya.
I sing God's praise and hear the excellences of that God, the Lord of wealth.
T6RG: The Lord is the Great Giver; all the world is begging; all beings and creatures are beggars.
The Lord alone is the Donor and the whole world is a mumper. The mortals and other beings are His beggars.
Q2WP: O Lord, You are kind and compassionate; You give Your gifts to even worms and insects among the rocks.
My God, You mercifully givest gifts even to the worms and insects in the stones.
NUTF: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, he has become truly wealthy. ||20||
Deliberating over the Name, through the Guru, slave Nanak has become wealthy.
E61Q: Reading and studying are just worldly pursuits, if there is thirst and corruption within.
Reading and reflecting are worldly affairs, if there are avarice and sin within.
9HF1: Reading in egotism, all have grown weary; through the love of duality, they are ruined.
Reading through egotism, all are grown weary and are ruined by the love of another.
6JM5: He alone is educated, and he alone is a wise Pandit, who contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
He alone is literate and he alone a wise Pandit, who ponders over Guru's hymns.
1C80: He searches within himself, and finds the true essence; he finds the Door of Salvation.
He searches his mind, finds the quintessence and obtains the door of salvation.

TQUQ: He finds the Lord, the treasure of excellence, and peacefully contemplates Him.
He attains the Lord, the Treasure of virtues and tranquilly meditates on Him.
YVMV: Blessed is the trader, O Nanak, who, as Gurmukh, takes the Name as his only Support. ||1||
Blessed is the trader, O Nanak, who, through the Guru, obtains the Lord's Name as his support.
YQPG: Without conquering his mind, no one can be successful. See this, and concentrate on it.
Without subduing his mind no man attains success. Let any one see it through deep deliberation.
BW3C: The wandering holy men are tired of of making pilgrimages to sacred shrines; they have not been able to conquer their minds.
The Pseudo-saints grow weary of roaming at the holy places, but this mind is subdued not.
4WZC: The Gurmukh has conquered his mind, and he remains lovingly absorbed in the True Lord.
Through the Guru, this mind is overcome in man's life and he remains absorbed in the True Lord's love.
PT78: O Nanak, this is how the filth of the mind is removed; the Word of the Shabad burns away the ego. ||2||
Nanak, in this way, the filth of the mind is removed, the Name burns off the ego.
DL4R: O Saints of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny, please meet with me, and implant the Name of the One Lord within me.
Meet me, O Lord God's saints, my brothers, and implant in me even a particle of the Lord's Name.
C08M: O humble servants of the Lord, adorn me with the decorations of the Lord, Har, Har; let me wear the robes of the Lord's forgiveness.
O God's slaves, bedeck me with the decoration of God's Name and make me wear the Divine dress of forgiveness.
8ETX: Such decorations are pleasing to my God; such love is dear to the Lord.
Such a decoration is pleasing to my Lord. The embellishment of love is dear to God.
E8M5: I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, day and night; in an instant, all sins are eradicated.
The Lord Master's Name, I utter day and night and, in an instant, It effaces all the sins.
FSB0: That Gurmukh, to whom the Lord becomes merciful, chants the Lord's Name, and wins the game of life. ||21||
He, to whom the Lord God becomes merciful, wins his life game, through the Guru, by meditating on the Lord's Name.
